== Name

index-terms-test - test index term rendering

== Synopsis

*index-terms-test*

== Description

A ((cat)) is a domestic animal.

We also mention a indexterm2:[dog] in the text.

Concealed terms: (((Animals, Mammals, Cats)))visible text after concealed.

Formatted visible terms: ((bold *primary*)), ((italic _primary_)), and
indexterm2:[mono `primary`].

Substituted visible terms: ((plain {name})), ((literal {styled})), and
((linked {linked})).

Direct link: ((direct https://example.com[Ada])).
